reasoning: A universally recognized horizontal battery icon filled to roughly two-thirds capacity. While originated as a UI status indicator for charge level, it works very well as a concrete subject icon for everyday tasks involving buying, charging, swapping, or recycling batteries and power banks. Its main weakness is low distinctiveness against other battery fill-level variants in the same icon pack.
